findings.issue: The new extension helpers readJson and stateRows return Record<string, any> (lines 648, 649, 652, 656). The resolver places this file in the SKILLED surface, whose universal checklist (Type Safety) says 'TypeScript: strict mode, no `any`', P2 when the type check passes. The base file had no `any`, and unlike the three `as any` added in stop-decision-yaml-contract.vitest.ts, which carry an eslint-disable and a stated reason, these carry neither. Case: any typo in a property path on the parsed config or state rows (for example after.lineage.continuedFromrun) type-checks, so the compiler cannot catch it.

evidence.out: 648, 649, 652, 656: four Record<string, any> sites, all added by this diff (0 at base 21c4b325b5a)

findings.issue: researchPackPath reads process.env.DEEP_RESEARCH_PACK_TEMPLATE at module scope. The comment says the override exists for the lockstep case, but the same path feeds every research-pack case: the rendered allow-list, the lineage render, findingsCount/keyQuestions, the narrative-to-nextFocus parse and both research frontier-block cases. Case: the manual playbook research-prompt-pack-contract.md step 4 sets the variable and runs the whole file, so several unrelated cases render the drifted copy and fail together, not just the lockstep case it means to prove. This falls under review.test-smells (test isolation). Fix: apply the override only inside the lockstep describe, and keep the shipped path for the other cases.

evidence.out: prompt-pack.vitest.ts:182 (module-scope const) and manual-testing-playbook/prompt-rendering/research-prompt-pack-contract.md:48 (sets it for a whole-file vitest run)
